title: Book Deep-Dive Model
description: Single source of truth for one book deep-dive, written once by the book-deepdive analysis stage and consumed by build_page.py. Lives at books/<slug>/book.json. RU is primary; EN comes from i18n/*.json at build time.

author.description: Full author name; the builder derives 'F. Lastname' for the navtag.

cover_alt_ru.description: Alt text for assets/cover.png (hero + hub thumbnail).

parts.description: The book's own parts (for the 'structure' strip). Optional but recommended.

summary_ru.description: 3-5 sentence RU thesis of the book.

sections.description: Teaching sections (≈ one per theme/part), in presentation order.

intro_ru.description: 2-3 sentence RU intro to the section.

source_docs.description: Filenames under sources/ for this section's deep-dive notes (linked from the section header).

id.description: Stable slug, unique in the book. Prefer kebab-case; underscore допустим (легаси-книги).

explanation_ru.description: Self-contained RU explanation (~70-140 words); English terms inline; weaves meaning + author's framing + a line of modern relevance.

analogy_ru.description: Optional memorable RU analogy (rendered as a callout).

quote_en.description: ONLY a verified/high-confidence quotation; else null. Audited adversarially before publishing.

visual.description: How build_page.py renders the concept's figure.

type.description: image → use the cached illustration if present, else fall back to `component`.

component.description: Name of an inline-SVG/CSS component (see reference/viz-components.md). Required for css/svg; recommended as fallback even for image.

alt_ru.description: RU alt text (used on for image visuals).

image_prompt.description: For image: text-to-image SUBJECT only (no style words).

cache_filename.description: For image: stable on-disk cache path under the book dir.

spec.description: Авторская спецификация замысла визуала (что показать/анимировать). Не читается build_page.py; сохраняется как design intent для перегенерации.

glossary.description: Key English terms → RU definitions. Stays on the book page (not merged into the course glossary).

qa_seeds.description: Active-recall questions for the on-page <details> Q&A.
